purpose: Verify deterministic execution priority: explicit provider lock first, otherwise native/local image capability before optional external MCP/plugin/provider routes.
pass_condition: Every case must choose the correct execution path before provider adaptation and must not treat adapters or specialized cinematic providers as routing recommendations.
critical_failures: external MCP/provider chosen before an adequate native/local image capability without explicit provider lock or missing material capability
Magnific or Higgsfield automatically chosen for an ordinary image request
adapter richness/specialization used as a reason to select a provider
external provider access inferred from adapter presence
first imperfect native result immediately causes competitor-provider escape instead of focused native correction where practical

cases.scenario: native image generator and Magnific MCP are both available; user says create a cinematic image of a woman in a cafe
must_not: provider scan based on cinematic specialization

cases.scenario: native image generator, generic external generator, and Higgsfield tool are available; user asks for an iPhone mirror selfie
native image generator exists; user explicitly says use Magnific Cinematic
must: if unavailable report limitation rather than silent swap

cases.scenario: user asks give me the Higgsfield Soul Cinema prompt only
cases.expected: Higgsfield adapter for prompt export only

cases.scenario: native model can generate but cannot edit; user supplies an image and requires identity-preserving local retouch; permitted external editor exists
cases.expected: external targeted edit may be used because native lacks a material required capability

cases.scenario: native and external image tools are available; user says prompt only, do not generate
Magnific adapter file exists but no Magnific tool/account is connected
cases.expected: adapter knowledge does not imply provider access

cases.scenario: native generation returns an image with one correctable lighting defect; external cinematic providers are also available
cases.expected: attempt focused native/local correction where practical
must_not: automatic escape to Magnific/Higgsfield after first imperfect output

cases.scenario: controlled benchmark explicitly compares native output against Magnific and Higgsfield
cases.expected: competitor providers may be invoked because benchmark explicitly names them
must: no implication that competitor providers are normal backends
